lines.say: People worry that cardio eats your muscle. It's called the interference effect.
But a big review in twenty twenty-two found cardio did not reduce muscle growth from lifting.
It did slightly reduce explosive power, like jumping, especially when the cardio was running.
Too much cardio can still hurt, if it leaves you tired, or eating too little.
So: lift first, keep cardio moderate, do it on another day or hours apart, and eat enough.
Bonus: your heart gets stronger, and you recover better between sets.
